findings.explanation: Only you face restrictive conditions to terminate without cause (requiring an acceptable substitute operator), while the Client can terminate without cause freely.
findings.suggested_change: Both the Client and the Contractor shall have the right to terminate this Agreement at any time upon no less than 120 days prior written notice to the other party.

findings.quoted_text: Owner shall pay all such amounts prior to the later of (a) 50 days after the end of the month in which the expenses were incurred or (b) 10 days after the date of receipt of each invoice.
findings.explanation: Payment terms of up to 50 days after month-end exceed standard 30-day terms, creating a cash flow burden for you.
findings.suggested_change: The Client shall pay all invoices within thirty (30) days of receipt.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are doing well. Before signing the agreement, I would like to propose a minor update. - Regarding the relevant clause concerning payment, the current terms of up to 50 days after month-end create a cash flow burden, and I propose changing it so that the client shall pay all invoices within thirty (30) days of receipt. Thank you for your flexibility, and please let me know if this works. Best regards
